study: NeuroLight-AI B-Dev-v2.1 Dynamic Observable Adaptive PI
observer_information_set: candidate u_t + 4 rate histories + 3 most recent action histories + intercept; exact frozen v1.2 representation, including omission of oldest fourth action
controller: strict incremental PI; observer may schedule PI gains but may not perform candidate-action search
gain_statistic: b0/b0_nom; true sensitivity is diagnostic only and never enters controller
selection: one global alpha minimizing equal-weight mean tuning tracking RMSE across sensitivities 0.60,0.80,1.00,1.20
anti_windup: conditional suppression of integral increment when it drives farther into saturation
observer_sanity: report whether mean b0/b0_nom is strictly monotonic increasing across validation sensitivities; do not retune if it fails
stop_rule: After this run, freeze/archive the result. Do not create v2.2/v2.3 to rescue performance. Proceed to Experiment-B protocol freeze/audit.
interpretation_limits: b0 is a scheduling proxy, not the simulator sensitivity parameter.
ARX prior uses 3 past actions rather than H4's 4; this frozen v1.2 representation is retained transparently.
Failure of this controller is not evidence that adaptive feedback is impossible.
